symptom: `describe navigation` (and `describe menu`) writes a menu caption with an apostrophe as `menu item 'Schema's'` / `menu 'Customer's orders' {`, which does not re-parse (`extraneous input 's' expecting {MENU_KW, '}'}`); the whole navigation statement is lost on describe -> exec
cause: printMenuMDL hand-rolled `'%s'` around item.Caption for both the item and the sub-menu line, and the action-note comments in menuItemActionMDL did the same; cmd_navigation.go was not in the file list of TestDescribers_HaveNoHandRolledStringLiterals
insight: Same class as the enumeration caption (mendixlabs/mxcli#394) and the workflow payloads (#1006): the source-scan guard only protects the files it lists, and every describer left off the list still had the omission. Adding the file to the list was enough to reproduce on main (10 hits: the two emits, six comment notes, two status lines). Re-parse test under both describe languages (`TestPrintMenuMDL_ApostropheInCaptionReparses`); end-to-end on a TestApp copy, the fixed describe output re-executes and describes byte-identical
